This is the main Lojban Wiki home of the '''Official Lojban Dictionary Project''' (Lojban: '''catni vlacku selgu'a'''), an official project of the [[LFK]].

Eventually, the Project will have not just a page but a whole wiki of its own, located at http://vlacku.lojban.org or something like that.  After the new wiki comes online, this page will continue to exist, and contain a summary and a description and a link for the new dictionary wiki.

In the meantime, we will use this page as a chalkboard for discussing ideas and drawing up plans.  Please add information and resources directly on this page.  Add questions and suggestions to the [[Talk:LFK_Dictionary_Project|discussion page]].  Anyone can participate in the discussion, add ideas, or make suggestions.

== Ideas and Opinion ==

The content of the material linked in this section is not necessarily approved, official, or going to be.  Please be advised.

Feel free to link whatever you like, but if the content contains opinion please do indicate that.
